# OS

`c.OS` calls the API's OS group. Get the operating system of target hosts.

## Methods

| Method                       | Returns                          | Permission | Description                           |
| ---------------------------- | -------------------------------- | ---------- | ------------------------------------- |
| [`Get(ctx, hostname)`](#get) | `*Response[Collection[OsEntry]]` | `os:read`  | Get the operating system of the host. |

### Get

```go
func (s *OSService) Get(
	ctx context.Context,
	hostname string,
) (*Response[Collection[OsEntry]], error)
```

Get the operating system of the host.

Reads the distribution and its version: the ID and VERSION_ID of /etc/os-release
on Linux, and darwin with the ProductVersion of sw_vers on macOS, such as darwin
15.5.

It sends `GET /api/node/{hostname}/os`, and needs the permission `os:read`.

The examples of the method's definition:

An Ubuntu host, `go run os.go get`:

```go
resp, err := c.OS.Get(ctx, target)
```
